job.title: Lead Full Stack Engineer | Hybrid in Raleigh, NC
job.description:
Position: Lead Full Stack Engineer

Location: Raleigh, NC (Hybrid)

Pay: $130,000 to $175,000/year

Experience:

  1. 7+ years of professional software engineering experience
  2. Experience designing and running production systems at scale

Education: An engineering degree is required

Type: Full-time

 

Array Corporation is seeking a Lead Full Stack Engineer! We're looking for experienced builders who enjoy solving meaningful problems for the frontline and essential economy with technology — especially when the solution doesn't look like a traditional app. This role is for builders who think in systems, challenge assumptions, and use modern tools to turn intent into outcomes. You'll own critical parts of the platform, shape architecture, influence product direction, and lead a team of engineers to deliver exceptional results.


Job Description:

  1. Lead a team of engineers, organize thoughts clearly, and motivate others through effective communication
  2. Build and operate distributed systems at scale on cloud infrastructure (AWS, Azure, or GCP)
  3. Design and run production systems with emphasis on reliability, performance, and security
  4. Apply solid application design principles and make architectural decisions with organization-wide impact
  5. Own complex features and systems end-to-end, from design through production
  6. Transform ambiguous requirements into scalable, stable engineering solutions


Position Requirements:

  1. 7+ years of full stack software engineering experience with 2+ years leading teams
  2. Experience designing and running production systems at scale on cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, or GCP)
  3. Strong technical judgment across architecture, data, and cloud infrastructure
  4. Ability to organize thoughts clearly, communicate effectively, and motivate team members
  5. Hands-on experience with C#, React.js, Infrastructure as Code, and design systems
  6. Strong understanding of application design principles and architectural patterns


Preferred Experience:

  1. Experience with AI-driven or automation-heavy systems Familiarity with event-driven, messaging, or conversational interfaces
  2. Experience connecting IoT devices to data platforms
  3. Evidence of curiosity: open source contributions, side projects, or experimentation


About Array Corporation:

Array Corporation is the leading technology-enabled workforce solutions company whose mission is to fix how work is bought, sold and delivered to enable access to the American Dream.

job.title: Junior Account Executive | Great Perks!
job.description:
Position: Junior Account Executive

Location: Raleigh, NC (Onsite)

Pay: $55,000 to $55,000/year + Commission

Experience: Previous retail, customer service, or sales experience is required.

Type: Full-time

Schedule: Monday - Friday, 8am to 5pm


Greene Resources is seeking a Junior Account Executive to join a growing team!


Job Description:

  1. Conduct a high volume of selling of company services
  2. Strategically allocate your time to activities that will best accomplish set goals
  3. Conduct effective discovery meetings that uncover pain points aligned with services
  4. Formally present/pitch/propose products and services as solutions to established problems
  5. Maintain accurate data and notes in a CRM or other similar database
  6. Negotiate contracts to maximize long-term and immediate value
  7. Forecast closed deals (sales, recruiting, etc.)
  8. Educate users, clients, and prospects about services, providing relevant and accurate information


Position Requirements:

  1. Ability to take feedback from managers and peers as a learning experience
  2. Effective communication skills with people at all levels of an organization
  3. Ability to build relationships and accomplish many detail-oriented tasks simultaneously
  4. Conduct sound business decisions analytically in a fast-paced environment
  5. Excellent follow-through skills and time management
  6. Able to work independently and in a team environment
  7. Possess excellent phone sales skills with a strong sense of urgency


Job Perks:

  1. Base Pay + Uncapped Commission
  2. Full Health Benefits (Medical, Dental, and Vision)
  3. 401k + Matching
  4. Weekly Pay


Greene Resources is part of Array Corporation, the leading technology-enabled workforce solutions company whose mission is to fix how work is bought, sold and delivered to enable access to the American Dream.
